wall-01.notes: Shrubs cover the wall; only the French doors of the west entrance are visible at the far left.

wall-02.notes: South front: Georgian Revival brick, pedimented center pavilion with an oculus and a pedimented entrance; about eleven bays over three storeys, round-arched windows on the ground floor of the east half.

wall-03.notes: Southeast end through trees: white entrance door, an arched loggia continues to the right (separate structure).

wall-05.notes: Northeast close-up: two twelve-over-twelve windows per floor in white frames; top floor assumed.

roof.notes: Slate gable roofs with a pedimented center gable and chimneys; modeled as a footprint-following hip.
